name: CarouselTokens
source: Material 3 spec — Carousel. Upstream ships no generated token file for it.
summary: A carousel: a row of items where the ones at the edges are squeezed rather than clipped.
variantEnumSummary: Multi-browse shows several items at once; hero gives one item most of the width.

SmallItemWidth.summary: How far an item is squeezed at the edge before it leaves.

sets.name: MultiBrowse
sets.summary: Several items at once, with the edges squeezed.

sets.name: Hero
sets.summary: One item at a time, with the next one peeking in.
